source_read: Grounded Kitchen's own ordering site https://groundedkitchen.vmos.io (the 'Order' link of www.groundedkitchen.com; the chain's allergen guide sends diners there for carbohydrate and sugar; robots.txt 'Disallow:' empty; its data host vmos2.vmos.io serves no robots file). Three restaurants picked as a visitor does: Leamington Spa and Metrocentre (the 'All day' menu shared by 8 of the 9 restaurants) and High Wycombe (its own 'All Day' menu); every category page and every product page rendered in headless Chromium, the product page's 'Nutrition' tab opened, one page at a time, 2 s apart; no 401/403/429 or challenge seen.
not_verifiable: allergens (the ordering site lists only the base dish's allergens, not the flavour's; link to the chain's allergen chart only); figures for the larger sizes of rice bowls and baos (printed only as '+NNN kcal')
notes: Extraction (tools/uk_extract/grounded_kitchen.py with vita_mojo.py) copies the 'Nutrition facts per serving' block of each product page (kcal, kJ, fats, carbs, saturates, sugars, proteins, fibres, salt) from the rendered page text. Second read, by a different method and path: the data answer each product page loaded (vmos2.vmos.io/catalog/bundles/<id>) holds the product's figures per 100 g and its serving weight (or the weight of the size the page opens on); every printed figure on all 248 product pages read equals per-100 g x weight / 100 at the printed precision (kcal within 1, grams within 0.05, salt within 0.005), and every tile's 'NNN kcal' on the category pages equals its product page's kcal. Rule for several sites: 0 products print different blocks at different restaurants; 4 shown at one restaurant only are left out; High Wycombe prints Chicken Bao twice with different blocks, so it is left out everywhere. Fixed in the script before publishing: sub-category products (rice, udon, ramen, laksa; baos and wraps; sides) had been missed on the first pass, and rice bowls and baos are published at the size their page opens on (named: 'Chicken Rice Bowl (Small)', checked against that size's weight). Left out: Bundles and Alcohol categories, drinks and coffee whose page prints no complete block, and a Barista Caffe Latte whose printed 130 kcal doesn't match its data (52).
